# Chinese APK manual build trigger

This file exists only to start a fresh Chinese APK build on branch `main`
without touching the default `master` branch.

To force a new build from the GitHub web UI:

1. Open this file on branch `main`.
2. Click the pencil icon (Edit this file).
3. Change the value below to any new text, such as the current date/time or a number.
4. Commit directly to `main`.

The commit will trigger the "Build Chinese APK" workflow and produce a fresh
permanently signed APK with a new CI versionCode.

trigger = 2026-09-26-01
